purpose: 20-network manuscript-candidate confirmation of fixed-set, fixed-latest temporal-order identification

pilot_provenance.method_selection_rule: The formal primary analysis remains the pilot primary analysis; pilot outcomes do not authorize endpoint, threshold, seed, K, delay, set, or scoring changes.

question: With item set, sequence length, latest input, timing and delay fixed, does the terminal Layer-2 joint u/x state identify the temporal order of the preceding items?

stimulus_identity_lock.formal_expansion_rule: Reuse the same 12 sets, image IDs, labels, roles, six orders and reference definitions; add identical per-network rows for seeds 1003-1019 only.

state_endpoint.terminal_time: after the delay following item D
state_endpoint.S0: fresh-state zero-input baseline with matched total elapsed time

primary_analysis.name: leave-one-set-out generative candidate matching
primary_analysis.outer_split: hold out one complete four-item set at a time within each network
primary_analysis.position_weight_fit: least-squares global position weights fitted only on the other 11 sets
primary_analysis.candidate_rule: All six candidates contain the same four items, D at slot 4 and the same parameter count; only the A/B/C-to-slot assignment differs.
primary_analysis.prediction: candidate with the highest score; exact numerical ties use the existing deterministic lowest-index argmax and are counted and reported
primary_analysis.aggregation: First aggregate 72 trials to one accuracy per network; then summarize the 20 network accuracies.

primary_inference.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval across 20 network accuracies
primary_inference.planned_test: two-sided one-sample Student-t test of network accuracy minus 1/6
primary_inference.reporting: Report all 20 networks, the mean, confidence interval, effect relative to chance and exact direction count; do not treat 1,440 trials as independent replicates.
primary_inference.multiplicity: One primary endpoint in this formal experiment; any manuscript-wide BH adjustment is applied downstream without changing this estimate or test family.

secondary_analyses.true_order_margin: true-order centered-cosine score minus best-wrong-order score, aggregated within network
secondary_analyses.confusion_matrix: complete 6x6 matrix with explicit zero cells; row-normalize within true order after equal network weighting

equal_weight_additive_comparator.status: pre-existing secondary mechanistic comparator; not promoted to primary after the pilot
equal_weight_additive_comparator.claim_use: Assess whether item-by-temporal-slot additive composition is sufficient for order identification.

label_permutation_null.scheme: within-set permutation of the six true order labels with predictions fixed
label_permutation_null.role: secondary calibration, not a replacement inference unit

latest_only_reference.status: analytical design reference, not an empirical predictor
latest_only_reference.reason: D and temporal slot 4 are identical in all six candidates, so latest-only information cannot rank the preceding orders.

validation_and_failure_policy.required_trials: exactly 72 valid order trials per network
validation_and_failure_policy.required_candidates: exactly six equal-complexity candidates per trial
validation_and_failure_policy.required_references: exactly 10 singleton item-by-slot references per set
validation_and_failure_policy.missing_stale_or_corrupt_parent: fail loudly; do not regenerate during load-only analysis
validation_and_failure_policy.network_exclusion: none after scoring; any unavailable network makes the formal bundle incomplete
validation_and_failure_policy.tie_reporting: report tie count per network and overall
validation_and_failure_policy.structural_checks: derive pass/fail from persisted stimulus, score and fold rows; never hard-code pass
validation_and_failure_policy.parent_hashes: record before and after formal analysis and require equality

prohibited_post_pilot_changes: changing K, delay, sample duration, item sets or order set
changing centered-cosine scoring or the primary endpoint
promoting equal-weight performance to the primary endpoint
adding a threshold or tuning parameters against formal outcomes
treating sets, orders, candidates, state dimensions or trials as independent biological replicates
allowed_conclusion: With the item set and latest input held fixed, the terminal Layer-2 joint u/x state identifies the preceding temporal order; secondary equal-weight analysis can establish whether this identification is consistent with additive item-by-temporal-slot organization.
forbidden_conclusions: generalization to unseen images without same-set singleton references
necessity or uniqueness of this mechanism in biological working memory
